narrative: Clarified end results for each CLI example README so users know what changes before and after running the scripts.
verbatim_user_input: In each examples README.md you will describe what is the end-results achived by the command ran in that example (what did we had before running that command ? What will we get after running that command ?)
scene: Before: READMEs only mentioned running scripts without context. After: each explains the state before and what output or knowledge is gained after executing the CLI.
